content:
The Bahrain Grand Prix will be broadcast live for free on Apple TV this weekend, with no subscription required. It is worth noting that the Bahrain Grand Prix is actually being held at the Sepang Circuit in Malaysia.

Normally, watching F1 events on Apple TV requires a paid subscription, but this weekend it is completely free for all viewers. You can catch up on the qualifying replay to get ready for tonight's main race broadcast, which starts at 3:00 AM US Eastern Time.

You just need to download the Apple TV app on a supported device, be in the United States, and stay up late to watch the live broadcast.

The live broadcast will begin at 1:50 AM Eastern Time, with the main race scheduled to start at 3:00 AM. Of course, if you want to sleep earlier, you can always catch up later through the on-demand feature.

You can download the Apple TV app on Apple devices, Amazon Fire Stick, Roku, PlayStation, Xbox, Android, and other platforms, or watch via the browser at tv.apple.com.

Qualifying has already concluded, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking his first pole position of the season, Lewis Hamilton in second, and championship leader Kimi Antonelli in third. This is Red Bull's most promising opportunity to challenge for the title so far this season.

You may be wondering why the Bahrain Grand Prix is being held in Malaysia. Under normal circumstances, the Bahrain round is usually held at the start of the season, but due to the ongoing conflict in Iran, the race had to be cancelled, and the Bahrain organisers decided to sponsor a race being held elsewhere in the world.

Although Sepang is no longer part of the official F1 calendar, as a circuit beloved by fans, it is expected to deliver exciting on-track battles for viewers.

Just a reminder again: watch for free on the Apple TV app, with no subscription required. The main race starts at 3:00 AM Eastern Time, with the live broadcast programme beginning at 1:50 AM.
